repos_data.description: A cross platform package to do curses-like operations, plus higher level APIs and widgets to create text UIs and ASCII art animations
Vector and raster maps with GL styles. Server side rendering by MapLibre GL Native. Map tile server for MapLibre GL JS, Android, iOS, Leafle...
jQuery plugin based on raphael.js that allows you to display dynamic vector maps
Vector map library and writer - running on Android and Desktop.
